rows.label: tlk47600165_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Ahh, feel that breeze... It
reminds me of the time I was
riding on the back of Seiryuu.

rows.label: tlk47600165_01_msg0002
rows.name:
It was when I was a little younger.
Seiryuu invited me on a long ride...

rows.label: tlk47600165_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I'd never left Iyasaki Village
before, but he took me to all kinds
of islands.

rows.label: tlk47600165_01_msg0004
rows.name:
I was asked to keep riding, but I get
seasick easily, so I gave Rex my place
on his back.
